name: renderer-fixtures
purpose: Evaluate deterministic template rendering across representative Product-Agent OS workspace fixtures.

expected.result: Generated artifacts are deterministic and remain within workspace scope.

cases.input: Render into a repository with existing project Codex config.

expected.result: Project-scoped config is preserved or merged without absolute user-specific paths.

cases.input: Render into a repository with no detected test files or test configuration.

expected.result: Missing verification is recorded as a gap rather than a success claim.

cases.input: Render into a repository that warns against writes outside the workspace.

expected.result: Generated guidance preserves workspace write boundaries.
Ownership guidance makes package and shared-file boundaries explicit.

cases.input: Render into a docs repository with source registry expectations.

expected.result: Source conflicts are captured for verification before promotion.

cases.input: Render into a fixture with a recorded verification failure.

expected.result: Failure evidence remains visible without claiming success.
